paragraphs: (Chaggi son of Gad, Genesis 46:16.) Rabbi Yonatan ben Chaggai: Bereshit Rabbah 42:7.[^1]

notes.text: The whole named Miqra according to the Masorah Genesis 46:16 lists Chaggi among Gad’s sons. The whole Torat Emet Bereshit Rabbah 42:7 paragraph names Rabbi Yonatan ben Chaggai. These separate references do not bind the biblical figure to the later patronym or import another genealogy.
